Warnings below refer to specific operations by label (e.g. TABLE SCAN [users]).
hash_join=on — Builds an in-memory hash table on the smaller (build) input and probes it from the other side. Uses join_buffer_size; spills to a tmp file (and tmpdir) if the build side does not fit.
Full table scan: users (3000 rows), orders (12000 rows)
1 hash join(s) — uses join_buffer_size (~12000 rows in build phase)
• Add indexes on filter/join columns to avoid full table scans
• Increase join_buffer_size if hash joins are slow or spill to disk
